notes.title: Just a quick update for everyone following In Retrospect on Steam
notes.notes:
Hey all!  Sorry that I haven't been updating here, I tend to do my updates on the In Retrospect website and social media, but I'm going to try to make sure I hit Steam with all updates now as well.  With that said, I recently posted a big update on my blog: Looking Back at 2021… In Retrospect!

If you have been following In Retrospect on Steam, you have probably noticed the release date keeps getting pushed back.  Long story short, the game IS coming soon.  I'm almost finished!  It's hard to give an exact release date yet, but I'm hoping to have the game out by this Spring.  Possibly a bit sooner, possibly a bit later.  We shall see.

The other new thing is I have a Discord now!  Join up and come say hello!

In fact, here is a list of various sites and social media accounts for Paper Salamander / In Retrospect that you can follow if you are so inclined.

In Retrospect website
Discord
Twitter
Facebook
YouTube


More coming soon!
